verdict.rationale: GitCafe's API reference says the REST API description is available as OpenAPI 3.1 JSON for code generators, which directly addresses the story. An automated probe got 404s at four guessed paths (openapi.json, swagger.json, etc.), but the docs never name those paths, so this lowers confidence rather than contradicting the claim. Missing for 10: the documented download URL for the spec, hands-on confirmation that the spec can be fetched, and independent corroboration.
